arxiv-2211-14910.title: On groups with few subgroups not in the Chermak–Delgado lattice
arxiv-2211-14910.creator: David Burrell, William Cocke, Ryan McCulloch
arxiv-2211-14910.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by David Burrell, William Cocke, Ryan McCulloch. We investigate the question of how many subgroups of a finite group are not in its Chermak–Delgado lattice. The Chermak–Delgado lattice for a finite group is a self-dual lattice of subgroups with many intriguing properties. Fasolă and Tărnăuceanu [ FT22 ] asked how many subgroups are not in the Chermak–Delgado lattice and classified all groups with two or less subgroups not in the Chermak–Delgado lattice.
